title: Remove handwritten Rust fixture baselines

title: Lower C int types to Rust i32
description: Implement lowering for C int types so generated Rust uses i32 for current test fixtures and the default Clang target ABI where int is 32 bits. This should make emitted fixture Rust reflect scalar integer types instead of leaving them untyped or incorrectly inferred. Do not treat this as a fully portable C integer model yet; future work should handle target-specific widths and other integer types explicitly.
close_reason: Lowered CIR integer types to Rust primitives, retained CIR aliases/target attrs, shared target Clang args across CIR and AST. Verified with cargo test and cargo run -- emit-fixtures.
